# Calendars

**EN** | [ES](../es/README.md) · [Back to the charts](../../README.md)

Subscribe to a pool to see its quiet hours for the coming week in your calendar, updated daily. Copy its link and add it as a subscription: in Apple Calendar, *File → New Calendar Subscription*; in Google Calendar, *Other calendars → From URL*.
